authority: User agreed Steps 2, 4, 5 and Step 3 with wider batch tuning; explicitly authorized autonomous Codex execution and verification between steps.

native_check.selection: First four calibration roots in each of eight piece/side/W-D cells; chosen before inference

baseline_use_policy: Keep exact FP16 engine as independent baseline after correctness checks, report raw numerical failures and drift. Do not require matching predictions or erase old failures. FP32 native fidelity remains required.
chess_scoring: Highest legal policy move; T=1 stable float32 softmax, lexical UCI ties. W->D/L or D->L is error by external theoretical Syzygy WDL, ignoring fifty-move rule. Not NN WDL argmax.
scales: All 1024 calibration roots only; signed symmetric per-tensor W8A8/max, scope v2 160 targets
INT8_quality: All 2048 validation roots only; no INT8 final-test inference in Week 1

timing.data: Calibration inputs only; method/batch selected without test outputs
timing.expanded_engine_policy: Separate timing engines from same graphs and precision controls; preserve exact accepted baseline. Verify precision and predictions; label tactic/profile differences. No replacement baseline or accuracy-driven builder search.
timing.refinement: Evaluate neighboring integer batch sizes around the best measured latency and best amortized time; if boundary best for throughput, extend once to 256 if memory permits. Report bounded optimum, never global guarantee.
timing.order: Seeded randomized batch order and alternating FP16/INT8 order, one GPU workload at a time
metrics: Resident GPU median complete-batch latency, CUDA events and synchronized host clock
Host input to host output complete-batch median latency
Latency divided by batch and positions/s; explicitly amortized, not single-position response time
timing.notes: Exclude loading/build/warmup; include full network conversions. Record thermal/device state. No MCTS batching/wait/search-strength conclusion.

later_weeks: No training, optimizer steps, smoothing application, PTQ ladder, B-side MCTS, energy or GPU lc0 integration.
